instruction: In the project directory, make a 'requirements.txt' file and write 'pytest' inside it.

metadata.explanation: Task variation 4: Requires user to create a new file 'requirements.txt' in the project directory. The evaluator checks if the file exists on the VM. Custom getter checks file existence by attempting to retrieve it from VM, custom metric compares the existence boolean against expected value. This is a simple file creation task similar in complexity to the original workspace creation task.
metadata.verification: Task requires creating a new file. Evaluator simply checks file existence which is straightforward to verify.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements - (1) file existence AND (2) file content
Getter logic correct: Retrieves file using env.controller.get_file() (file.py:21), decodes bytes to UTF-8 string (file.py:27-34), returns both existence flag and content (file.py:36)
Metric logic correct: Checks both existence match (metrics/file.py:15-20) and content match with whitespace handling (metrics/file.py:26-31)
Data flow correct: Getter returns {'exists': bool, 'content': str}, metric compares both fields against expected {'exists': true, 'content': 'pytest'}
Edge cases handled: Returns {'exists': False, 'content': ''} if file not found or empty (file.py:23-24), handles decoding errors gracefully (file.py:27-34)
Whitespace handling: Metric uses .strip() to handle trailing newlines, preventing false negatives from text editor line endings
Evaluator can correctly distinguish: empty file (fail), wrong content (fail), correct content (pass)
